youtube.title: Paying the Minimum on a $5,000 Card Takes 19 Years #Shorts
youtube.description:
Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card at 22% APR can take about 19 years and cost about $8,240 in interest. Paying $200 a month clears it in under 3 years.

• Average APR on cards charging interest: 22.36%, Q3 2026 (Federal Reserve G.19)
• Card companies charged about $160 billion in interest in 2024 (CFPB, Dec 2025 report)
• Illustration: minimum = 1% of balance + interest, $25 floor, no new charges. Your card's formula may differ.

Full guide on the channel: "How Credit Card Companies Make Money Off You".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
